title: Exceptional Gaudi tour
text: Maria was an excellent guide!  She was extremely knowledgeable and did an incredible job of explaining the history and the meaning behind every detail. 10 out of 10 experience that I would highly recommend.

title: A morning of beautiful treasures
text: Cecelia provided an outstanding introduction and overview of two architectural treasures.  We also enjoyed a walking tour including Gaudi and nearby homes.  We definitely recommended this tour!
author: 472StevenB

title: Excellent Private tour with Maria Carmen through WithLocals.com
text:
We had an absolutely outstanding experience with Maria Carmen—she was hands-down one of the best guides we’ve ever had.
